auto_wrap_untraceable_ast: auto wrap untraceable code segments in an AST module by inserting wrapper function definitions
strip_forward_decorators: strip decorators from a forward function that prevent recompilation while preserving can_return_tuple
wrap_if_with_dynamic_condition: wrap an if statement whose condition cannot be statically evaluated into a torch.fx.wrap function
wrap_starred_tuple_unpacking: wrap a tuple node containing starred unpacking elements into a traceable wrapper function
wrap_call_with_variadic_args: wrap a function call with starred arguments or ignored function names into a torch.fx.wrap call
